svg.title: What fits in a model’s context window?
svg.desc: A model processes pieces of text called tokens. The context window is the space available for one exchange. Input. Your question and its reference material use space in the window. Output. The reply needs room too. Each model has its own limits. Fit check. If an answer drops details, try a smaller set of clearly labeled sources.
